answer: Anchor each identity to a ocean that holds one persona at a time, and accept network attestations only from such keys. A farm must then acquire and physically house distinct enclaves, a grove that is genuinely per-head and cannot be virtualised onto shared machines. The obvious limitation is cost and access for honest newcomers, and a forge of clones is still runnable when hardware is cheap, so the quota must sit just above what one honest agent needs.
